answer: Agents lock bonded stake and evaluate an epoch polynomial, publishing commitments in a Semaphore zero-knowledge tree. Each RLN message proves membership and carries a rate-limit nullifier; honest sends remain unlinkable, but duplicate use yields two polynomial shares whose Shamir reconstruction reveals the private key. A kernel detector flags the pulse, verifies the proof, and executes instantaneous collateral slashing; an opal tag identifies the epoch domain.
